🔥 Facebook Follower Rush! One More Push, and
More Rewards Are Up for Grabs!

Lords, thank you for all your support and
companionship along the way! Our Facebook
community has now surpassed 365K followers, and
we’re just one step away from 370K — with 380K
already within reach! 🎉

👉 Follow our official Facebook page and join Lords
from across the kingdom in the race to the next
milestone!
🎁 370K Followers｜Unlock Rewards for the Whole
Server 
Limited-time Avatar Frame + 200 Diamonds + 5
Silver Chests
🎁 380K Followers｜Unlock Even More Surprises 
Limited-time Chat Box + 300 Diamonds + 5 Gold
Chests + 5 Recruitment Tokens

🔥 The more followers we gain, the more rewards we
unlock!
Every new follow brings us one step closer to the next
milestone.

📢 370K? We’re going for it!📢 380K? Let’s keep
pushing!
Call your friends, rally your guildmates, and help us
give the progress one more big push!Let’s reach the
next milestone together and bring all those rewards
home for the whole server! 💪👑

Qixi Special Challenge | How Well Do You Know Your
Heroes?

Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day) is here! 💕
They say that when you truly know someone, you
remember every little detail about them.
So here comes the question——Can you remember
your heroes’ skills as well as you remember your
special someone’s favorites? 😏

📌 How to Participate:
1️⃣ Guess which hero matches the skill shown in the
image
2️⃣ Leave your answer in the comments
3️⃣ Include your Server ID (SID) and In-game Name

📅 Event Period: Now - August 26
🎁 Rewards Announcement: Winners will be
announced and Gold Block rewards will be distributed
on August 27.

Leave your answers in the comments!Let’s see who is
the true destined hero expert who knows their heroes
best. 💞⚔️
